0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets, who are 0-4 and on a four-game losing streak, host the Detroit Pistons, who are 4-1 and lead the Central and the East after winning their last game. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and Detroit won the last series 3-1 in 2025-26, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
